events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused: 120 of 400 records have migrated, and 31 overseas customers have incorrect phone numbers because the new CRM added +1 to numbers without country codes. Batches 4–10 (280 records) remain; the same issue would affect overseas records in those batches. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the past 24 hours, though it is not known whether they saw affected records. Please advise on the authoritative source for correct country codes and the fix for the migration mapping. I recommend correcting and validating the 31 affected records, then fixing the mapping before resuming.
